Score Management using Object Pointers
Problem Statement

Create a class Student with:

Private data members:

string name

int marks

Public member functions:

void input() → to take user input

void display() → to print name and marks

static double calculateAverage(Student* arr[], int n) → calculate class average using object pointer

Program Requirements

Take integer n as input (number of students).

Dynamically create n Student objects using new.

Store their addresses in an array of object pointers.

Take input for each student.

Display all student details.

Display the average marks.

Properly delete all dynamically allocated objects.
